question: m15
q: Which of Sydney's commercial centres has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek right now, and which the quietest?

transcript.answer:
**Busiest Fridays: Chatswood. Quietest: North Sydney.** These are the latest figures, for September 2026.

The measure is Friday tap-ons between 3pm and 7pm as a share of the Tuesday–Thursday average. A value of 1.0 means Fridays are as busy as midweek.

| Centre | Friday ÷ Tue–Thu (Sep 2026) |
|---|---|
| Chatswood | 1.03 |
| Strathfield | 1.00 |
| Parramatta | 0.81 |
| Sydney CBD | 0.78 |
| Macquarie Park | 0.77 |
| North Sydney | 0.74 |

- **Chatswood** is the only centre where Friday evenings are busier than midweek. It has been near or above 1.0 since February, apart from April (0.94) and July (0.96). Strathfield is level with midweek at 1.00.
- **North Sydney** has the biggest Friday drop-off, at about 26% below midweek. It has stayed between 0.70 and 0.76 all year. Macquarie Park (0.77) and the CBD (0.78) are only slightly better.
- Chatswood and Strathfield may be busy on Fridays partly because they have a lot of retail and dining. These taps cover people leaving from 3pm to 7pm, so they may include shoppers and diners as well as office workers.

The CBD figures may be understated if Sydney Metro taps aren't included. That affects comparisons with 2020. It doesn't affect the comparison between days within the same month.
